prefixConvention: The first segment is semantic domain unless a signal has a side prefix. sideScope is the acting/owning card side. corp.* on runner-side signals denotes the affected Corp state/zone, not Corp as the acting side.
supportOnlyAnchorPolicy: supportOnly=true signals cannot cause strategy anchors; reports must distinguish card-level strategy anchors observed from signalMayAnchorStrategy.
broadSignalPolicy: Generic aggregation and legacy signals such as economy.generic, economy.recurring, setup.search, setup.recovery, setup.draw, defense.damage_prevention and run.make_run are broad_support/not_for_direct_scoring unless a precise signal or reviewed strategy evidence also exists.
